method: Read-only primary public website extraction using Exa; no authenticated product sessions or proprietary code inspected.
coverageLegend: Categories indicate features observed or advertised in cited public pages; absence is not proof the competitor lacks a feature.

competitors.name: Teal
competitors.workflow: Set goals → save jobs → attach a job description → tailor a resume → submit on employer site → track status.
competitors.reference: Per-job workspace with resume versions beside the job description.
caveats: No claim that Teal auto-submits; its own comparison says it does not.

competitors.name: Rezi
observedFeatures: PDF and DOCX export on paid plan
competitors.workflow: Build → score → paste target job → fix keyword gaps → export.
competitors.reference: Explanatory section-level checks and clean document editing.
caveats: Scores are proprietary product metrics, not verified employer ATS outcomes.

competitors.name: Jobscan
competitors.workflow: Upload resume + paste job listing → inspect match report → edit → rescan.
competitors.reference: Two-input matching and actionable missing-skill report.

pricing.notes: Not captured from a dedicated pricing page.

caveats: ATS-specific performance and interview multipliers are vendor claims; do not repeat as our guarantees.

competitors.name: Resume Worded
observedFeatures: AI LinkedIn profile review entry point
competitors.workflow: Start LinkedIn review → create account → profile review (authenticated steps not observed).
competitors.reference: Dedicated LinkedIn review entry point tied to resume quality.

pricing.notes: Pricing and signed-in review details not observed.

caveats: The fetched public page exposed mainly signup; do not claim detailed private workflow parity.

competitors.name: Careerflow
competitors.workflow: Upload resume or start LinkedIn optimization → repair profile/document → save roles → autofill → track applications and networking.
competitors.reference: One shared profile powers the resume, LinkedIn and job-search tools.

pricing.notes: Homepage shows Free and Premium tiers but responsive pricing extraction interleaves amounts; no reliable plan amount asserted.

caveats: Autofill is distinct from unattended auto-submission.

competitors.name: HeadshotPro
competitors.workflow: Upload selfies → choose style → generate → select favorites → crop/download.
competitors.reference: Explicit upload quality checks, style selection and download gallery.
caveats: Generation speed, realism, privacy and satisfaction claims are vendor statements; implement only promises the app can honor.

competitors.name: Aragon
competitors.workflow: Upload photos → select attire/background → generate → edit/download.
competitors.reference: A limited set of professional styles and optional edits after generation.

pricing.notes: Promotional and crossed-out prices coexist in capture; verify checkout before purchase.

caveats: Current page also markets a wider image/video suite; focus on headshots for this product.

competitors.name: Simplify
competitors.workflow: Create career profile → receive matches → tailor resume → autofill employer form → track.
caveats: Public homepage summary captured; authenticated extension behavior not tested.

competitors.name: LoopCV
competitors.workflow: Upload CV → set titles, locations and filters → review matches or activate auto-apply → track applications/emails and replies.
competitors.reference: Visible automation settings, exclusions and a separate review queue.

pricing.notes: Direct pricing FAQ says €9.99; other regional/competitive sources show different tiers. Treat as locale-sensitive starting price.

caveats: Separate matches, queued tasks, emails and confirmed form submissions in our app; do not count them as one metric.

competitors.name: Sonara
competitors.workflow: Tell the service about your background → receive matches → service applies → monitor.
caveats: No logged-in use, application correctness, or actual submission delivery tested.

competitors.name: Wonsulting NetworkAI
competitors.workflow: Set networking goal → identify contact → draft from resume → copy/open LinkedIn or email flow → save and track.
competitors.reference: Resume-supported personalized outreach with editable saved drafts.

pricing.notes: Observed in rendered public FAQ through actual REA on 2026-11-08, evidence ev_271027f326bc758ac78730386dbfa6a0a0ab9e0f42d3f76c100d292305e0d42b; checkout not exercised.

caveats: Guaranteed-interview language is vendor marketing; not adopted.

competitors.name: Hunter
competitors.workflow: Choose company/contact → find and verify email with sources → draft sequence → send through connected inbox → track.
competitors.reference: Verification status and source provenance before outreach.

pricing.notes: 50 is a lead quota, not a price. No paid pricing captured.

caveats: Adjacent B2B outreach tool, not exclusively a job-seeker platform; no fabricated recruiter emails.
